_status: in-progress: 2026-08-17; 14 tasks built + validated (gold=1.0/base=0.0/det x3, docker), sourcing toward 23. See CANDIDATES.md and MEASUREMENT_PLAN.md.
_note: VulcanBench Python Suite v1: 23 Python-only tasks from real merged post-cutoff OSS PRs, graded by hidden deterministic tests in a network-isolated Docker sandbox. A direct response to v3 saturation (16/23 v3 tasks were passed by every frontier config, 2/23 by none, leaving ~3 truly discriminating). Design rules (CHARTER.md): (1) difficulty band -- compose so the MEDIAN frontier model lands ~50-70% aggregate pass@1, reject floor tasks aced by every config, cap easy anchors at ~3 and ceiling tasks at ~3; (2) error bars -- admit and rank only on repeat>=3, never n=1; (3) harness != capability -- wall-clock DNF and infra errors reported separately from wrong answers, budgets scaled per repo so a solvable task is not failed by the clock. Every task carries a `domain` tag (web-async, data-orm, parsing, scientific, stdlib-utility, cli-tooling, concurrency); no more than ~3 tasks per upstream repo. Coverage floor >=3 fail_to_pass per task, each verified to fail at base; pass_to_pass never references the new feature. Every task gated by scripts/validate_tasks.py: gold=1.0, pre-patch=0.0, deterministic over 3 runs.
